question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of oil product pipelines and a list of refineries in the United States, with location, operator, capacity and status?

answer.summary: EIA's Refinery Capacity Report (Form EIA-820, 1 Jan 2026) lists 130 operable refineries by company, state and city with crude distillation capacity (18.16 million b/cd; 128 operating, 2 idle) and shutdowns, but no coordinates were retrieved. Pipeline routes are not downloadable by the public: PHMSA NPMS shows hazardous liquid lines one county at a time (+/-500 ft) and gives line data to government and operators only; its public county sheets give active miles by operator and commodity. Open line files found are EIA crude oil (236) and HGL (133) layers on geo.dot.gov.
main_caveats: Pipeline routes: PHMSA NPMS public access is a county-at-a-time viewer with a minimum accuracy of +/-500 feet; line data is released to government officials and operators only.
The line files found (EIA crude oil and HGL copies on geo.dot.gov) are layers named _202001 with only operator and pipeline name fields; they are not refined-product pipelines.
EIA refinery data are tables by city; no coordinates were obtained, so refineries cannot be mapped from the tested files.
EIA counts 130 operable refineries; 124 have crude distillation rows, and the other 6 are non-refinery operators of downstream units.
Capacity units differ: refinery capacity is barrels per calendar day or stream day, while NPMS gives pipeline miles, and no pipeline throughput was found.
NPMS mileage sheets (data as of 2026-07-16) are totals by county, operator and commodity, not segment geometry or capacity.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA workbook and tables and NPMS sheets were downloaded and counted; refinery coordinates and EIA's product-pipeline layer could not be reached.

attributes.note: NPMS shows hazardous liquid lines one county at a time, no download; open line files found are crude oil (236) and HGL (133), not refined-product lines.
attributes.gap_note: NPMS line data goes only to government officials and operators. EIA's petroleum-product layer was not reached: the Atlas needs a browser, the NETL copy returned an error and the data.gov entry gave 404.

attributes.note: EIA lists 130 operable refineries by company, state and city (SITE) with PADD; no coordinates in the workbook. Precision is municipality.
attributes.gap_note: EIA's refinery point layer (services7.arcgis.com) answered 'Token Required' and the NASA HIFLD mirror did not connect, so no coordinates were tested.

attributes.note: Refineries: EIA COMPANY_NAME on 130 sites. Pipelines: NPMS operator per county and commodity (280 crude, 172 non-HVL product) and opername on EIA copies.
Refinery crude distillation: 18,160,493 b/cd operable (EIA, 1 Jan 2026) plus downstream and production capacities. No pipeline throughput field found.
attributes.gap_note: No throughput or capacity attribute appears in the NPMS external data dictionary (Mar 2023) or in the EIA line copies, whose fields are operator and pipeline name.

attributes.note: Refineries: EIA operating/idle (128/2) and a 2025 shutdown table. Pipelines: NPMS public sheets only count Active mileage (abandoned excluded).
attributes.gap_note: NPMS segment status codes (Active filled, unfilled, abandoned) come with line data restricted to government officials and operators.

example.example_request: curl -sL -O https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/refinerycapacity/refcap26.xlsx  # sheet 'refcap26': keep SUPPLY == 'Atmospheric Crude Distillation Capacity (barrels per calendar day)' and PRODUCT == 'TOTAL OPERABLE CAPACITY' (124 rows)
example.example_result: COMPANY_NAME LAZARUS ENERGY LLC, STATE_NAME Texas, SITE NIXON, PADD 3, PRODUCT TOTAL OPERABLE CAPACITY, QUANTITY 14000. Sum over the 124 rows: 18,160,493 b/cd (operating 18,126,493 over 122; idle 34,000 over 2).

problems: The EIA petroleum-product pipeline layer is not in the DOT listing; the NETL-hosted EIA_pipeline_data service returned a web-adaptor 'Application Error' page on 2026-11-24.

if_unstructured.summary: Pipeline route geometry for refined-product lines and refinery coordinates were not obtained from open files; PHMSA releases NPMS line data to officials and operators on request.

local_terms.meaning: Petroleum Administration for Defense District, EIA refining regions 1 to 5.
Barrels per calendar day and per stream day, units of refinery capacity.
PHMSA category covering crude oil, refined products, NGL and other liquids.
Refined products that are not highly volatile liquids, in NPMS commodity codes.
Hydrocarbon gas liquids / natural gas liquids.
National Pipeline Mapping System and its account-based viewer for officials and operators.
